parts:
資料用ggplot2中的例子~

library(ggplot2)
df=tips
head(df,10)
   total_bill  tip    sex smoker day   time size

9       15.04 1.96   Male     No Sun Dinner    2
10      14.78 3.23   Male     No Sun Dinner    2
資料如上述

我的問題是我只想要篩選出day裡面的Sun跟Sat
此外必須還是要為完整的df中的所有欄位

我傳統作法為
sun=df[df$day=="Sun",]
sat=df[df$day=="Sat",]
rbind(sun,sat)

不知道各位先進有沒有更好的方法?
可以一次篩選出day欄位中的任意兩個變數
我是有用過subset不過弄來弄去都只能篩選一個變數...

感謝~

messages.author: 229645a23bcc2845
messages.subject: Re: 請問如何篩選dataframe中某一欄特定的兩個類別變數?
parts:
The function you are looking for is ? subset
df <- subset(df, day %in% c('Sat', 'Sun'), )

or

df <- df[df$day %in% c('Sat', 'Sun'), ]

If your dataset is huge, checkout this package called 'data.table'. data.table intro
Instead of using vector scan, data.table utilize binary search.

parts:
Hello,

You can also try

df[df$day=="Sat" | df$day=="Sun",]

for small to medium dataset. Above are called the logical indices and vectorization that is encouraged to use by the R community. Thanks for your question.
